description: Ranged Shadow, Nature and Fire caster. Keeps Hex of Malice rolling, chains Bad Juju, Malefic Wrath and Hexfire into it, and supports the party by amplifying and absorbing rather than healing.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_witch-doctor__voodoo.txt and the 'voodoo' tree in reference/coa_sidekick/talents/witch-doctor.json. CoA calls it the Augmentation Evoker analog: 'fundamentally damage-dealers whose support value comes through buff and debuff windows and redirect-style cooldowns rather than sustained HPS ... Like Augmentation, it barely casts heals.' Nothing in this tree heals, deliberately - its stated weakness is 'No ally heal in the spec at all: no HoT, no direct heal, no off-heal filler.' Its stat priority is Spell Hit > SPIRIT > Spell Power > Haste > Crit > Intellect, which is why four nodes here spend on Spirit and two convert it into spell damage.

nodes.name: Staff of the Coven
nodes.description: Increases your Spirit by 2% and your spell hit chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Spirit by 8% and your hit chance by 2%' at 3 ranks. Spirit leads this spec's stat priority (Spell Hit > Spirit > Spell Power), which is unusual for a damage tree and is what Voodoo Power below is for.

nodes.name: Stranglethorn Style
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 1% per rank and reduces the threat your spells generate by 3%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your critical strike chance by 4% and reduces threat generated by your Voodoo spells by -20%'. threat_generation_pct as a TALENT effect is a fraction, unlike the same key in an ability's stat_mods.

nodes.name: Dark Magic
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Malefic Wrath by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cast time of Malefic Wrath and Bad Juju by -0.3 sec'. Cast time is not a concept in a turn engine, so the node carries the throughput that shorter casts would have bought.

nodes.name: Loa Spirits
nodes.description: Restores 2 Mana every 5 seconds and increases your Spirit by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt and healing done now has a 8% chance to collect a Spirit. In addition, each active Spirit now increases your Spirit by 2%.' Spirits are not a resource here (see the module docstring), so the stack becomes what it was for: Mana back, and more Spirit.

nodes.name: Voodoo Power
nodes.description: Grants spell damage equal to 2% of your Spirit per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your spell damage by 50% of your Spirit and your spell hit rating by 5% of your Spirit.' A real <target>_from_<source>_pct conversion, resolved against the shared STAT_CONVERSION maps in character.py. This is the node that makes Spirit a damage stat.

nodes.name: Zalazane's Malice
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Hex of Malice by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Hex of Malice by 15% and the duration of Jinxes by 2 sec'; the rotation is built on 'Keep Zalazane's Malice up'.

nodes.name: Overflowing Juju
nodes.description: Increases your Shadow spell power by 4 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the spell power scaling of Malefic Wrath, Shadowflare, and Bad Juju by 20%' - all three are Shadow, so the node grants Shadow spell power directly.

nodes.name: It's Da Voodoo
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Shadowflare by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA ships this one as 'Increases the damage of Shadowflare by 0%' - a real bug in the source data. The intent is obvious from the name and slot, so it carries a real number here.

nodes.name: Ritual Hexing
nodes.description: Increases the Shadow damage you deal by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Bad Juju, Malefic Wrath and Hexfire by 10% against enemies affected by Hex of Malice.' Conditional-on-a-debuff damage has no hook, so it lands as flat Shadow damage. shadow_spell_damage is one of the school keys the engine assembles at runtime.

nodes.name: Growing Malice
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your damage-over-time effects by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each tick of Hex of Malice increases the damage of the next tick on the enemy by 3%, stacking 10 times.' Ramping per-tick damage is not modellable, so the whole ramp is paid out flat.

nodes.name: Hexplosion
nodes.description: Your critical strikes increase your haste by 4 per rank for two turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your offensive critical strikes now increase your haste by 20% for 6 seconds.'

nodes.name: Jin'do's Wrath
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance and critical damage of Hexfire by 25%.' crit_damage_spell is read through get_talent_effect only, which is why it belongs in the tree and not in a buff's stat_mods.

nodes.name: Prolonged Malice
nodes.description: Hex of Malice lasts 1 turn longer per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the duration of your Hex of Malice by 6 sec and the range of your offensive Voodoo spells by 6 yds'. Range is not a concept here; duration is.

nodes.name: Voodoo Strings
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Bad Juju by 5% and of your Nature damage-over-time effects by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'When Bad Juju is used on enemies affected by Puppeteer's Threads, it strikes an additional time every 1 sec for 30% of the damage dealt over 3 seconds as Nature damage.' Both halves of that - a bigger Bad Juju and a Nature tail - without the thread condition, which has no hook.

nodes.name: Hollow Spirit
nodes.description: Your damaging spells leave the target taking 2% more damage per rank for three turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Shadowflare and Hexfire now increases the chance enemies are critically struck by 3% for 12 seconds.' Crit-taken has no status hook on a monster, so the debuff amplifies damage taken instead - the same thing a higher crit rate is worth. Note damage_taken_pct is the ONE status _pct key the engine reads raw as a fraction.

nodes.name: Voodoo Mind
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Shadow Puppets by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Shadow Puppets now ticks -10% faster and lasts 10% longer for each Spirit active on you' - faster ticks over a longer window is more total damage.

nodes.name: Dark Loa's Blessing
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the all damage dealt by party and raid members by 3%.' GAP: a talent's effects only ever apply to its owner - there is no party-wide talent aura - so the party half is lost and the Witch Doctor keeps the damage. This is one of the two nodes CoA points at when it calls the spec an Augmentation Evoker.

nodes.name: Dark Effigy
nodes.description: Increases the damage your abilities deal to additional targets by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Bad Juju and Hexfire now strike 2 additional nearby enemies.' Adding targets to a single-target spell is not expressible, so the node makes the spec's existing cleave hit harder instead.

nodes.name: Malicious Golems
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of War Golem by 1 turn and increases your haste by 1 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Summoning your War Golem now increases your spell haste by 30% for 20 seconds. In addition, periodic damage dealt ... will reduce the cooldown of War Golem by -0.5 sec.' Both halves, paid flat.

nodes.name: De Other Side
nodes.description: Your damaging spells build power, granting 10 spell power and 2% spell critical strike chance per rank for a short time.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Shadow Puppets now increases your damage and critical strike chance by 1% for 20 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.' The stack is the spec's engine ('Keep your De Other Side stacks alive off Shadow Puppets so your damage stays high'); without a stack-count field on a talent proc it is one refreshing window instead of ten.

nodes.name: The Price of Power
nodes.description: Increases your Spirit by 3% and grants spell damage equal to 2% of your Spirit per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Voice of Bwonsamdi now increases your Spirit by 100%.' A cooldown-conditional doubling is not expressible, so the node pays flat Spirit and doubles down on the conversion that makes Spirit matter.

nodes.name: Juju Spirits
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 2% and your spell critical strike damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your spell critical damage by 100% and increases the critical strike chance of Bad Juju by 5% for each active Spirit on you.'

nodes.name: Voice of Bwonsamdi
nodes.description: He has been waiting for you to ask.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Voice of Bwonsamdi is your big damage cooldown', and the spec is rated PvE S with 'Strong sustained single-target DPS on patchwork fights - high throughput ceiling', so the payoff is throughput rather than utility.
